product.title: Nakuldana - Small (250g)
product.description: Delight in the unique taste of our Small Nakuldana, a traditional snack that provides a crunchy texture and nutty flavor. Each 250g pack is filled with small, nutritious seeds that are perfect for snacking or adding to your favorite dishes. Rich in protein and essential nutrients, nakuldana is a great choice for a healthy snack. Enjoy them roasted as a standalone treat, incorporate them into trail mixes, or sprinkle them over salads for added crunch. With Soil Wise Nakuldana - Small, you can indulge in a deliciously wholesome snack!

product.title: Nakuldana - Big (250g)
product.description: Savor the rich flavor of our Big Nakuldana, a delightful variety of seeds that offer a satisfying crunch and nutty taste. Each 250g pack contains large, nutritious seeds that are perfect for snacking or enhancing your culinary creations. Packed with protein and essential nutrients, big nakuldana is a fantastic option for a healthy treat. Enjoy them roasted as a snack, mix them into trail mixes, or use them to add texture to salads and dishes. With Soil Wise Nakuldana - Big, you can enjoy a deliciously wholesome snack anytime!

product.title: Gond Katira - (250g)
product.description: Discover the unique properties of Gond Katira, a natural gum resin known for its health benefits and versatility. Each 250g pack is perfect for incorporating into traditional recipes or enjoying as a nutritious snack. Gond Katira is rich in dietary fiber and is believed to support digestive health. Use it to make refreshing drinks, puddings, or as a thickening agent in recipes. With Soil Wise Gond Katira, you can enjoy the wholesome goodness of this traditional ingredient while nourishing your body!
